verdict.rationale: OpenAI's tools guide lists remote MCP servers as a first-party way to extend model capabilities, next to built-in tools and function calling. It also says tools can let the model access third-party services. So the API itself acts as an MCP client. The evidence is only a one-line listing, though, with no setup detail. Missing for 10: configuration and authentication docs for connecting MCP servers, any mention of local (non-remote) servers, tool approval or filtering controls, and independent or hands-on confirmation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: you can extend capabilities using built‑in tools, function calling, Programmatic Tool Calling, tool search, and remote MCP servers
